knowledge:
- key_parameters: genome=The input genome sequence, which can be a BSgenome object or a DNAStringSet ;; directory=The path where the GMAP/GSNAP genome index files will be created and stored ;; create=Logical; if TRUE, the genome index is built ;; k=The k-mer size for the genomic index (e.g., 12L) ;; spliceSites<-=Used to insert known splice sites (as a GRangesList of exons) into the GmapGenome index ;; unique_only=Logical; whether to restrict alignments or tallies to uniquely mapping reads ;; novelsplicing=Logical; whether to enable novel splice site detection ;; splicing=Name of the known splicing database to use (e.g., "knownGene") ;; minimum_mapq=Minimum mapping quality for a read to be included in the tally ;; min_base_quality=Minimum base quality for a nucleotide to be tallied
- alternatives: GMAP=Mentioned as particularly suited for relatively long mRNA and EST sequences (e.g., Roche 454, PacBio), whereas GSNAP is optimized for short reads (Illumina, SOLiD)
- when_to_use: Use when you need to align short-read sequencing data (RNA-seq or DNA-seq) using GSNAP directly from R, or when you want to perform nucleotide-level summarization (coverage, allele counts, indels) on BAM files using bam_tally
- pitfalls: Building a genome index can be computationally intensive; the documentation recommends saving and packaging the index using makeGmapGenomePackage to avoid rebuilding it ;; bam_tally returns an opaque pointer to a C-level data structure, which must be processed with a summarization function like variantSummary to get a usable R object (VRanges)

workflows.name: short_read_alignment_gsnap
workflows.intent: Build a genome index (with optional splice sites) and align paired-end short reads (FASTQ) using GSNAP.
workflows.stages: 1. Create a GmapGenome index ;; 2. Extract and assign known splice sites ;; 3. Configure alignment parameters using GsnapParam ;; 4. Align reads using gsnap
workflows.code:
gmapGenome <- GmapGenome(genome = p53Seq, 
                         name = paste0("TP53_demo_", 
                           packageVersion("TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene")), 
                         create = TRUE, 
                         k = 12L)
exons <- gmapR:::subsetRegion(exonsBy(txdb), roi, "TP53")
spliceSites(gmapGenome, "knownGene") <- exons
gsnapParam <- GsnapParam(genome=gmapGenome,
                         unique_only=FALSE,
                         suboptimal_levels=2L, 
                         npaths=10L,
                         novelsplicing=TRUE,
                         splicing="knownGene",
                         indel_penalty=1L,
                         distant_splice_penalty=1L,
                         clip_overlap=TRUE)
gsnapOutput <- gsnap(input_a=fastqs["H1993.first"],
                     input_b=fastqs["H1993.last"],
                     params=gsnapParam)

workflows.name: variant_tallying_bam_tally
workflows.intent: Tally nucleotide-level coverage and allele counts from a BAM file to identify variants.
workflows.stages: 1. Load or create the GmapGenome object ;; 2. Configure tally parameters using BamTallyParam ;; 3. Run bam_tally on the BAM file ;; 4. Summarize the tallies into a VRanges object using variantSummary
workflows.code:
genome <- TP53Genome()
param <- BamTallyParam(genome,
                       minimum_mapq = mapq,
                       concordant_only = FALSE, unique_only = FALSE,
                       primary_only = FALSE,
                       min_depth = 0L, variant_strand = 1L,
                       ignore_query_Ns = TRUE,
                       indels = FALSE, include_soft_clips = 1L, xs=TRUE,
                       min_base_quality = 23L)
tallies <-bam_tally(bam_file,
                    param)
variantSummary(tallies)

workflows.name: create_gmap_genome_package
workflows.intent: Package a GmapGenome index into a reusable R package for distribution and reproducibility.
workflows.code:
makeGmapGenomePackage(gmapGenome=gmapGenome,
                      version="1.0.0",
                      maintainer="<your.name@somewhere.com>",
                      author="Your Name",
                      destDir="myDestDir",
                      license="Artistic-2.0",
                      pkgName="GmapGenome.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm3")
